Messages.Author: Henrik Isaksson
Messages.Body:
When taking the action to burn a location, the action will fail if the acting minion does not
possess the bomb when the action resolves (after being Masked, or if the Bomb was transferred or
destroyed somehow). [RTR 19960221]

Another minion really cannot play mask on a bemb-destroy action, right, making part of above ruling
obsolete. What if two minions both have a bomb? Can they then mask back and forth, or is it the same
case as, for example, beast and theo bells rush actions?

/Henrik Isaksson
